n: Google AI Literacy Guide (Be Internet Awesome)
t: A free Google PDF of AI literacy lessons for grades 2 to 8.
steps: Find the Understanding AI guide on the Google educators page for Be Internet Awesome.
Print the lessons you plan to teach.
Read the three lessons and choose the order.
Check the grade range of each lesson against your class.
Look at other Google AI literacy resources at ai.google/literacy.
Teach the lessons as a supplement to your regular units.
